notes: The two load-bearing differences from a myitems process table (shapes/widget_view_table.json): flow_type='Form' (NOT 'Dataset') and view_id='allitems' (NOT 'myitems'). The engine's prior Dataset-bound guess (flow_type='Dataset', view_id='myitems') rendered 'Unable to display component'; this Form/allitems binding is what copilot chose for a dataform.

flow_id AMBIGUITY, unresolved (THE RULE): copilot bound flow_id to the dataform's name-SLUG WITHOUT the _A00 app suffix (captured as 'R2_Data'), while the dataset's API _id carries the suffix ('R2_Data_A00'). Either page widgets bind datasets in a different id namespace, or copilot mis-slugged. Both forms are flagged; the RENDER check that resolves which id actually loads is still owed — the shape above uses a synthetic single-token id to avoid encoding either guess as truth.
RENDER UI-pending: the graph is coherent and fully wired but was NOT opened in the builder to confirm it renders (headless capture). Strong candidate, not proven-live.

Direct forge_build_page does NOT validate flow_type — it accepted BOTH 'Form' and 'Dataset' with view_id='allitems' and read both back coherently. So the tool can produce this working shape today by passing flow_type='Form' + view_id='allitems' explicitly, but it will just as happily produce the broken one; a WIDGET_REQUIRED_CONFIG tightening is owed once render confirms the id form.
showform=true and newItem=true are display config (not binding) — they are NOT mirrored into Component.Data, same convention as widget_view_table.json's showform/steps.
